messages:
migs: Heads up — customers reporting p99 spikes on Meridian (new model) after the onboard. Mainly on long inputs (>8k tokens). Started ~Mar 10. Seen timeouts and 5-8s tail responses.

jess: Noted, do we have a repro request? any specific client or route?

migs: Happens on /v1/generate and /v1/chat for a handful of tenant ids. Example request (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "meridian-v1",
  "input": "<~9k token doc>",
  "max_new_tokens": 1024
}
```

alex: Reproduced locally on a dedicated dev node. p95 ok, p99 jumps when sequence enters >4096 active kv length. CPU <10% but GPU kernel runtime shows slow attention path selection.

sasha: Any tokenizer diffs? We switched to a normalization patch during onboarding to handle complex unicode — could be splitting into more tokens.

migs: Good call. Logs show average token count increased ~12% for affected calls. KV cache hit ratio drops and we see more cache evictions in /var/log/kv-cache.log.

ivor: Stack traces from runtime:
```
2026-03-10T10:14:03Z kernel_select: selected_attention_kernel=generic_softmax_opt
2026-03-10T10:14:03Z kvcache: miss_count=124 evict_count=18
2026-03-10T10:14:03Z request: latency_ms=5892
```

alex: Looks like kernel selector flips to slowpath when seq_length > 4096 or when memory layout changes (non-contiguous kv). New tokenizer normalization might be introducing extra subword boundaries, increasing effective seq length and fragmenting kv layout.

jess: Actionable items: 1) get tokenization diffs on representative inputs 2) capture kernel selector logs + runtime traces for impacted requests 3) attempt warm-kv preload or force-kv-enabled route for affected tenants 4) consider rolling back tokenizer normalization on meridian model if confirmed.

migs: I'm attaching a small repro harness to run against staging:
```bash
# run with long input file
python tools/repro_meridian.py --input long_doc.txt --model meridian-v1 --warm-kv
```

sasha: I ran tokenizer delta on sample set. The normalization change adds NFKC decomposition on some emoji sequences and CJK punctuation, increasing token count by ~9% median. I've uploaded token_diffs.csv to the thread.

alex: Experimented: forcing kernel hint to fastpath (override) reduces p99 by ~2.8x for same inputs, but only safe for short term. Warm-kv reduced p99 by ~35% for steady flows.

ivor: Also seeing a small rate of timeouts coming from upstream client side when server latency hits ~6s. Support tickets piling up.

support-bot: Created escalation ticket #INC-2026-2145 and notified enterprise-SRE pager.

migs: Quick mitigations deployed to staging: 1) pin tokenizer to previous commit for meridian-v1 variant 2) enable kv-warm for top 5 affected tenants 3) add kernel selector debug flag. Rolling to prod in 30m if green.

jess: Long-term: we should update onboarding checklist — tokenization impact smoke tests, seq-length distribution checks, and kernel selection simulation. Also add an automated gate: if average tokens increased >5% compared to baseline, stall rollout.

alex: I'll follow up with a perf RFC describing: tokenizer normalization tradeoffs, kv layout invariants, and a safer kernel fallback policy.

sasha: For now, notify impacted customers that we're rolling a mitigation and we'll follow up in the next 2 hours.

migs: Thanks all. I'll post prod rollout outcome in this thread. :thumbsup:
